midshotsToday.terms: 20 runners; house 1/4 odds, top 3; bookmaker terms may be better
midshotsToday.reason: Past course-and-distance win, form 211233, and a recent third at York over a longer trip supply a genuine place argument. OR93 compared with historical RPR111 warrants a handicap review. At 16/1 the price compensates partly for 20-runner uncertainty.
midshotsToday.risk: Twenty-runner Class 2 heritage-type handicap is volatile. Today's soft ground and stall 1 may alter the run style; published pace sections are incomplete. Not Prime win confidence.

midshotsToday.reason: Two recent wins within the form line 439151 and good prior results on good-to-soft provide a genuine late-developing handicap profile. RPR91 compared with OR78 merits a closer look at this mile trip. Early 14/1 is available from a number of sources.
midshotsToday.risk: York has turned soft, slower than the going on which recent wins came; 20 runners and a crowded midfield pace are notable negatives. This is the least confident midshot and can be dropped if going gets heavier.

midshotsToday.reason: Won and finished second in the previous two runnings of this same Naas Listed sprint; acts on soft going, and a better recent handicap run suggests he is returning to form. RPR114 and an early 13/2 give a more grounded place case than most 6/1+ candidates.
midshotsToday.risk: Current seasonal form has been inconsistent (form -60035), and 9 Listed sprinters could place competing early speed under severe ground. Stable/rider statistics are modest; this is still a conditional E/W bet.

midshotsToday.terms: 29 runners; house 1/4 odds, top 3 (bookmaker can offer additional places)
midshotsToday.reason: Progressive form 171211, four wins from six handicap starts, and staying on strongly over two miles support a 2m2f Cesarewitch tilt. RPR113 versus OR85 indicates peak form has exceeded historical mark; early odds 9/1 are more appealing than the market leaders.
midshotsToday.risk: 29-runner heritage handicap with heavy traffic, draw position and an additional two-furlong stamina test. The RPR/OR comparison is contextual, not a guaranteed handicap advantage. Big-field luck is essential.

midshotsToday.reason: Consecutive wins near the end of last season, including an Aintree success, support upside in a £42,713 Premier Handicap Hurdle. Jonjo O'Neill Jr rides; RPR147 and TS137 demonstrate ability for this standard at about 10/1.
midshotsToday.risk: 183-day absence and a 7lb increase in the handicap mark. This is a deep 18-runner race with fit improving rivals, and no verified fresh-running guarantee.

midshotsPolicy.publicNote: Evidence-based 6/1–18/1 E/W values, not guaranteed place chances. Emphasis on course/going, recent form, mark and plausible race shape.
midshotsPolicy.priceRule: Price is recorded from Saturday morning quotes. Do not substitute later SP in the paper tracker.
